result.summary: Found 2 distinct issues: a major layout issue causing text overflow/cut-off in a restaurant card, and a minor accessibility issue with insufficient contrast on secondary text elements.

issues.description: The restaurant name "Smash Bros Burgers" in the "Fastest near you" horizontal card row overflows its card bounds, with the end of the name cut off at the right edge of the card's text area.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text container to fit the full name: either enable text wrapping to break the name into two lines, reduce the font size of restaurant names in this section, or widen the card to accommodate full-length names without overflow.

issues.description: Secondary text (delivery fee text like "€0.90 delivery", "€2.40 delivery", and delivery time text like "25-35 min") uses light gray text on a white background, which has low color contrast (fails WCAG 4.5:1 contrast ratio for readable text), making it hard to read for users with visual impairments.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker gray tone (or adjust text color) to meet WCAG contrast requirements, ensuring these secondary text elements are clearly legible against the white background.
